body: UX not great.
author: 3GS Kiwi

title: Indispensable
body: Most comprehensive alarm/timer app ever. I use it several times a day, every day. I particularly like the way it converts system reminders into Due alarms – means you can set a Due alarm by telling Siri to remind you of (something) at (some time). Not so likeable: sometimes an alarm acknowledgement takes time to percolate through to other devices.
author: SteveNZ

title: Unsupported - no help available
body:
The app itself is great but there is no support. I bought two apps (one for me and gifted one for my husband) and can't find out how to share tasks. I've emailed about 3 times now over the past month or so, with no response from the developer at all. My husband can't/won't use the app as we don't know how to share tasks with each other, or even if that feature is in the pipeline. I'd be happy to write a detailed and positive review if you guys could just respond to my support requests.  Thanks. 

Update: it's been 8 months with no response to support requests now (since June 2016).

title: Excellent
body:
Such a simple app to use, clean, elegant and gets the job done. Really does make keeping track of those 'I really should get that sorted' jobs so much easier to track.

Update: support first rate and recent updates for the frequency of recurring reminders had taken usability to the next level.  Highly recommend this app.

title: One of the best!
body: I am now totally organized! Love the gorgeous clean interface. Love the simplicity and the fact that it does exactly what it promises. Love the fact that there are no added and unnecessary elements. FAQ in the settings from the developer about what is included and why is a real bonus.
